mechanism: Isotretinoin is highly teratogenic and semaglutide delays gastric emptying which may reduce isotretinoin absorption and efficacy; additionally, both drugs have metabolic effects on lipids and glucose homeostasis that may complicate clinical monitoring.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use reliable contraception (isotretinoin requires iPLEDGE program compliance), monitor lipid panels and glucose closely, and consider alternative acne treatments or alternative diabetes management.
